source: Microchip Technology press release: Microchip Adds the LX-820 Quartz Oscillator to its L-Series (10-22-2026)

players.product: radiation-hardened / radiation-tolerant MCUs and MPUs (VORAGO, HARDSIL process) and the radiation-tolerant Space CSAC-SA65 chip-scale atomic clock for LEO satellites

quarterly_data.signal: Microchip launched the LX-820 radiation-tolerant quartz oscillator, expanding its L-Series timing devices for Low Earth Orbit and other space applications: a 3.2 mm x 2.5 mm surface-mount package, -55 C to 125 C operation, MIL-PRF-55310 Level B, +/-100 ppm, CMOS outputs from 1.25 MHz to 135 MHz and LVDS outputs from 100 MHz to 250 MHz; L-Series oscillators passed TID and SEL testing with radiation tolerance up to 50 krad. Many L-Series configurations are available from stock or with lead times of less than 20 weeks, and the LX-820 and other L-Series oscillators are now available in production quantities.
quarterly_data.figure: radiation tolerance up to 50 krad; lead times under 20 weeks
